content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The essential qualification is one of the following two routes: Ph.D. (awarded or thesis submitted) in Computer Science & Engineering / Information Technology / Software Engineering / Cyber Security / Artificial Intelligence / Electronics & Communications / Mathematics & Computing or a closely related discipline. OR M.E./M.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering / Information Technology / Software Engineering / Cyber Security / Artificial Intelligence / Electronics & Communications / Mathematics & Computing or a closely related discipline, with minimum 60% marks or equivalent CGPA. For Ph.D. candidates: one research paper publication in SCI/SCIE-indexed journals. For M.E./M.Tech candidates: two years of relevant post-qualification experience, and two research paper publications in SCI/SCIE-indexed journals. Desirable qualifications are not mandatory and will be used only for preference during shortlisting. Hands-on experience in Deep Learning / Machine Learning / Natural Language Processing / Text Summarisation / Large Language Models (LLMs) / Reinforcement Learning / Python Programming / Cyber Security / Information Security. The age limit is 40 years. Age relaxation, if any, applies as per Government of India / DTU / funding agency norms. The notice does not print an "as on" date for counting age. Candidates who are currently employed must submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer at the time of joining. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The monthly emolument is ₹87,100/- (consolidated, inclusive of all components). No additional allowances such as HRA, TA, DA, medical benefits or any other benefits are admissible. The position is for 12 months or co-terminus with the project, whichever is earlier. It is a purely contractual, project-based position, and may be renewed subject to satisfactory performance, availability of project funds and approval of the Competent Authority. A three-month satisfactory assessment period is mandatory for continuation of the engagement.

content_sections.heading: DTU Data Scientist Job Description
content_sections.text: Develop and maintain data analytics pipelines, benchmarking frameworks, performance metrics and dashboards for objective evaluation and monitoring of cybersecurity audit reports and auditing organisations. Perform the assigned work and assist the Chief Investigator in various phases of the research project. Prepare technical reports, documentation, datasets, software deliverables and/or research publications as directed by the Chief Investigator, in line with the project objectives and funding agency requirements.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DTU Data Scientist

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection is carried out by shortlisting of applications based on eligibility and relevant experience, followed by an interview of the shortlisted candidates by the Selection Committee. Desirable qualifications are used for preference during shortlisting. The interview date is not printed. Shortlisted candidates will be informed through email only, and all communication with shortlisted or selected candidates is made only through email and/or the official website. No TA/DA is paid to candidates appearing for interviews or selection-related processes.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected for the DTU Data Scientist post?

faq.question: Q9. Is the DTU Data Scientist job permanent, and are HRA or other allowances paid?
